scenarios.name: global_null
scenarios.description: Complete global null: no main, interaction, or transform signal.

scenarios.name: interaction_null
scenarios.description: Main effects (including both binary switches) and a nonlinear main-effect transform, but no true interactions.

scenarios.name: sparse_strong_hierarchical

scenarios.name: weak_signal
scenarios.description: Same hierarchical support as sparse_strong but low signal-to-noise.

scenarios.name: correlated_redundant
scenarios.description: Dense active set with many candidate pairs (redundant active and inactive predictors) stressing selection precision.

scenarios.name: pure_interaction

scenarios.name: nonlinear_misspecified
